description: Reverse-ETL / search-index activation: sync an upstream DataFrame into an Algolia index via the native /1/indexes/{index}/batch endpoint. id_field's value becomes each record's objectID; all other columns become document fields. Supports 'upsert' (updateObject, create-or-replace) and 'delete' (deleteObject).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Algolia record, keyed by id_field -> objectID.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_submitted / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_id / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Algolia.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

id_field.label: ID Field
id_field.description: Upstream column whose value becomes the Algolia record's objectID.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: 'upsert' create-or-replaces via updateObject; 'delete' removes via deleteObject.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Algolia Index Upsert
